style.styleTitle: Dibor Woodland Walk Christmas Finish 150cm Garland
style.toneOfVoice: This long, natural light up garland features pinecones dotted with glittering golden berries and vibrant green leaves for a truly festive Christmas decoration. Drape this luxury garland around your banister or on the mantelpiece of a blazing fireplace to create a cosy log cabin atmosphere in your own living room. You could even wrap this rustic garland around your Christmas tree for a contrasting look. The natural colours and textures of the real pinecones are a traditional feature that will complement any home interior. Bring the magic of the festive season to your home year after year with our generously sized garland that conjures up a stroll through a winter wonderland.
